content.title: Two Sum
content.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution.
hints: A brute force approach would check every pair of numbers with nested loops
That will work, but it has O(n^2) complexity. Can you think of a more optimal solution using a hash map?
Think about what you need to find for each number to complete the target sum
edge_cases: Large numbers close to integer limits
follow_up_questions: What if the array was sorted?
What if there were multiple valid solutions?
How would you handle duplicate numbers?
